changelog:
Initial release of ugc-ad skill:

- Enables creation of creator-style or UGC ad videos, including testimonials, product demos, unboxings, or faceless voiceover cuts.
- Supports two presentation modes: direct-to-camera avatar (TTS or user-supplied audio) and faceless voiceover over product footage.
- Guides input collection: ad format, script or audio, specific product info, target platform/orientation, plus optional avatar/voice/brand background/captions.
- Outlines a strong social ad workflow and build-order (hook, context, product moment, proof, call to action).
- Integrates with HeyGen Avatar V, OmniHuman-1.5, and related models, ensuring up-to-date model use via live schema checks.
- Details composition and model parameters for optimal output tailored to TikTok, Reels, Shorts, or YouTube/Web.
